plan_review.notes: ROUND 1 (before initial cherry-pick/implementation): Alt A: fold exit-prefix logic into moveToward directly - rejected. Alt B: fix playerInSafeRoom flicker at the source - rejected as insufficient alone. Alt C: generic movement-constraint hook - rejected, YAGNI. Chosen: post-selection pure route-constraint overlay (unchanged from WIP). divergence=minor for round 1. ROUND 2 (mid-session, maintainer-mandated after a proven cloud-gate regression: 4 baseline-clean cells regressed under heavy-combat RETREAT/ENGAGE churn near a doorway): proposed a room-scoped egress-attempt tracker; adversarially reviewed and REJECTED as too coarse: (1) room-wide suppression could over-suppress a genuinely different, easily-reachable target through a different door in a multi-door room; (2) the progress metric (distance to each reactivation differing buffered endpoint) was not stable/comparable across reactivations; (3) missing explicit navEpoch/topology-change handling; (4) potential ordering interaction with provider watchdogs; (5) same-room frames treated as invisible discarded real geometry signal; (6) the same-room sustained-retire threshold was gameable by combat-speed oscillation. Reviewer proposed exit-frontier-scoped tracking (key persistence to the specific resolved door tile, not the whole room) plus provider-level dwell alternatives as stronger candidates. Implemented the reviewer recommended design: bestEndpointDistanceFt/noProgressFrames now scoped to a stable attemptExitKey (originRoomId plus pre-buffer exit tile), continuing across same-door reactivations and same-room-bypass interludes, with a generous (1800-poll) dormant-decay safety valve chosen far above any realistic combat-oscillation period to prevent gaming, and suppression/release action unchanged. divergence=major_fork for round 2 (the room-scoped design was abandoned for exit-frontier scoping). All 16 cumulative concerns across both rounds addressed via fixes or documented, evidence-backed acceptance (see commits ca0b3532, 7ba26085, 14a02d19, 4398394d).
